name: smartbyte products design features.pptx
path: SmartByte/暂时不用的/smartbyte products design features.pptx
text:
[slide 1]
Tight control of differential impedance
eight-layer board design, high frequency board
Senior Layout Engineers with years of Data Centre Switch design experience
Separate signal wire from source noise as much as possible
Sufficient consideration of EMC/EMI in circuits and design details
Multi-layer reference board to ensure signal integrity

[slide 2]
Surge and static protection devices
Air duct isolation design convects heat away from the source and reduces the impact of heat sources on the mainboard.
Heat transfer silicon makes full use of the chassis to dissipate heat
Improve EMC/EMI by using contact shrapnel in the contact part of the upper and lower cover of the chassis.
High-quality source and fan ensure long-term stable and reliable operation
MAC and PHY with Marvell solution
PSE with Realtek solution

[slide 3]
High heat dissipation factor silicon and aluminium block to enhance heat dissipation performance

[slide 4]
Power module PCB's solder mask opening convenient for high-power devices on the inner PCB through the external aluminium profile to enhance conduction heat dissipation

[slide 5]
Iron shell opening, direct conduction of high power devices to aluminium profiles helps to dissipate heat

[slide 6]
Aluminium heatsinks on inner PCB core devices,
directly conduct to outer profiles


[slide 7]
The board interface fold ensures that the interface with metal shrapnel is in full contact with the chassis.

[slide 8]
Conductive foam on the top and bottom of the chassis to improve EMC


[slide 9]
Unpainted at the combination of the upper and lower covers of the chassis to increase the conductivity.

[slide 10]
Board mounted terminals design are useful for rapid discharge of electrostatic surges

[slide 11]
Customised LOGO
Specification
Serial Number
Custom Login IP
MAC Address
SNMP OID
Hardware customisation: Supports hardware customisation for 1G to 100G Ethernet switches
Customisation
Software customisation


[slide 12]
Marvell / Microchip      Chemi-con / Infineon
SFP+ interface with heatsink
Electroless Nickel / Immersion Gold
UDE network port







[slide 13]
Warehouse
constant temperature and humidity
first-in-first-out
adequately stocked

[slide 14]
Production
full quality control
First Article Confirmation
electrostatic protection
High temperature aging
First Article Confirmation





[slide 15]
Sample room
(material sealing to ensure consistency of incoming material)



[slide 16]
Lab
Temperature, humidity and flow testing
Static Test
Surge Test

[slide 17]
File encryption for preservation
Prohibition of customer information on the production area
Separate warehouse for customised materials
Computer lockout prevents use of external copy device
Controlling access to customised information
Confidentiality
Production
